notes.title: Game Update August 12 2023
notes.content:
Character dialogue portraits have been updated! 
Some other artwork has also been reworked.

notes.title: Small Update July 8th 2023
notes.content:
-A prompt will now appear after launching the game displaying keyboard and controller inputs.

-Melee combat is slightly less mashy. Animation speed and enemy invincibility frames have not been changed but sequencing into the next melee combo attack now requires the attack input to be on the third frame or greater of attack animations rather than the second frame or greater. 

-Mashing the jump button to float in the air indefinitely by going in and out of the slowfall state is no longer possible.

Thanks to everyone who has provided feedback!

notes.title: Small Update July 6th 2023
notes.content: While using the grappling hook, visual queues have now been added to indicate when the player has enough momentum to launch themselves at a higher speed.

notes.title: Small Update July 5th 2023
notes.content: Pressing the Escape Key will now toggle fullscreen on and off instead of exiting the game immediately.

notes.title: Small update. July 3nd 2023
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for their feedback! A pop-up tutorial has been added explaining how the grappling hook works in greater detail. 
Also, an update to the dialogue portraits is in the works. I know they are kinda bad. I was there, I drew them. :D
Thanks to everyone for taking interest and showing support.
I will try my best to tidy things up the best I can.
Cheers!
-SnuggleFry

notes.title: Phantom of Zana Update June 17th.
notes.content:
Keyboard input remapping has now been added to the settings menu. It might still need some polish but to the best of my knowledge it works appropriately.
